senses.gloss: c. (v. כְּרַךְ2) fortified place, in gen. city, capital.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 3b:13">Meg. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ שישב ולבסוף הוקף</he> a place which was first settled and then fortified.
<cite ref="Chagigah 13b:5">Ḥag. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>בן כ׳</he> an inhabitant of a city, a refined person, opp. <he>בן כפר</he>.
Succ. 51ᵇ he who has not seen Jerusalem in her glory, לא ראה כ׳ וכ׳ has never seen a beautiful city; a. fr.—כ׳ גדול (של רומי) Rome.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21b:15">Snh. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ ג׳ שברומי</he> ed. (Ms. <he>של ר׳</he>); <cite ref="Shabbat 56b:14">Sabb. 56ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 759:9">Yalk. Num. 759</cite> <he>לדחוף את שרה של כ׳ ג׳ וכ׳</he> to drive out the genius of Rome &c.; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> (corr. acc.); Pesik. Par., p. 41ᵃ (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. <he>כְּרַכִּים</he>, <cite ref="K01205"><he>כְּרַכִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 21b:18">Erub. 21ᵇ</cite> judge me not <he>כיושבי כ׳</he> like the dwellers in large cities (where there are many vices).
<cite ref="Ketubot 110b:4">Keth. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>ישיבת כ׳ קשה</he> living in large cities is a hardship.
Sifré Deut. 52 Remus and Romulus arose ובנו ב׳ כ׳ ברומי and built two forts in Rome (Cant. R. to I, 6; Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ צריפים); a. fr.—כְּרַכֵּי הים sea-towns, mercantile ports (Tyre &c.).
Cant. R. to I, 4; a. fr.—[Ruth. R. to II, 4 בין הכרכים, read: באַרְכִיָים, v. אַרְכִי I.]—כְּרַךְ Fort …, v. respective determinants.
